data.name: Ehsaan
data.gender_notes: Ehsaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘ehsan’ which means ‘to make something beautiful’ or ‘to make something better’. In Islamic tradition, Ehsaan is the name given to a person who has achieved the highest level of righteousness and kindness. This name is a reminder to always strive towards goodness and generosity. The name Ehsaan carries the meaning “Goodness, Kindness, Generosity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ehsaan usually hope their child will grow to embody goodness, kindness, generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the pursuit of good deeds and kindness towards others.
data.etymology: Ehsaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goodness, Kindness, Generosity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ehsaan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: إحسان
in_arabic.meaning: إحسان تعني الإحسان إلى الآخرين والإحسان في العمل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإحسان هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الإحسان إلى الآخرين والإحسان في العمل، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، قال تعالى: ﴿اللَّهُ لَإِيلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ﴾، وقد وردت أيضًا في الحديث النبوي الشريف، حيث قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الإحسان أن تعبد الله كأنك تراه، فإن لم تكن تراه فإنه يراك»

in_urdu.name: احسان
in_urdu.meaning: احسان کا مطلب ہے حسن سلوک اور اچھائی
in_urdu.long_meaning: احسان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حسن سلوک اور اچھائی، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور حدیث نبوی شریف میں بھی اس کا ذکر ہے، رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے احسان کی تعریف کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ احسان یہ ہے کہ تم اللہ کی عبادت ایسے کرو جیسے کہ تم اسے دیکھ رہے ہو، اور اگر تم اسے نہیں دیکھ رہے ہو تو وہ ضرور تمہیں دیکھ رہا ہے

in_hindi.name: ईहसान
in_hindi.meaning: ईहसान का अर्थ है दूसरों के साथ अच्छा व्यवहार करना

historical_references.reference: Ehsaan ibn Abdul-Qari ibn Abd al-Uzza ibn Qusayy, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, was named 'Ehsaan' as a mark of respect for his good deeds and hospitality towards the Prophet.
historical_references.context: Ehsaan was a prominent member of the tribe of Quraish in Mecca and was known for his generosity and kindness towards the Prophet Muhammad and his followers. When the Prophet Muhammad migrated from Mecca to Medina, Ehsaan was one of the first people to pledge his allegiance to him and provide him with shelter and supplies.

historical_references.reference: Ehsaan al-Mausoori, a famous Islamic scholar and poet, lived during the Abbasid Caliphate in the 9th century AD. He was known as 'Ehsaan al-Mausoori' because of his exceptional knowledge and wisdom in various fields, including fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence), hadith ( Prophetic traditions), and poetry.
historical_references.context: Ehsaan al-Mausoori was born in Mausar (present-day Iraq) and studied under some of the most eminent scholars of his time. He is famous for his works on Islamic jurisprudence, particularly his commentary on the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad called 'Al-Ehsaan fi Tamheed Sunnah al-Nabawi'. He was also a renowned poet and wrote many ghazals and qasidas, which are still studied and appreciated in the Islamic world.
